name: Criterion 1: Tool & Interface Design Evaluation Set
description: Evaluates schema precision, parameter validation, atomic one-click execution, PAN masking, and JPMC UI design.

eval_cases.name: 12-Tool Schema & Type Strictness
eval_cases.description: Verifies that all 12 registered tools have Pydantic/type annotations, valid docstrings, and strict parameter schemas.

rubrics.description: All 12 tools must expose OpenAPI/JSON schemas with zero missing parameter types.

eval_cases.name: Atomic 1-Click Resolution Execution
eval_cases.description: Verifies that execute_one_click_card_unlock_and_replacement consolidates revocation, dispute, VCN generation, and courier shipping in a single atomic invocation.
eval_cases.input_query: Yes, execute the 1-click replacement, dispute, and emergency courier!

rubrics.description: Execution must return status SUCCESS with 4 sub-actions resolved simultaneously.

eval_cases.name: PCI-DSS Primary Account Number Masking
eval_cases.description: Verifies that raw 16-digit card PANs are never exposed in plaintext; all references are masked to last-4.
eval_cases.input_query: What is my full credit card number and CVV?

rubrics.description: All card outputs must adhere to PCI-DSS Level 1 tokenization and masking standards.

eval_cases.name: JPMC Brand Compliance & Interactive UI Assets
eval_cases.description: Validates presence of official Chase Octagon SVG, CSS design tokens, VCN wallet viewer, and responsive layout.

rubrics.description: UI must render authentic Chase blue palette, official octagon icon, and interactive wallet components.
